# Yahoo

> > Yahoo is a global media and technology platform offering news, finance, search, email, entertainment, and lifestyle content.

Yahoo provides comprehensive coverage of breaking news, stock market data through Yahoo Finance, celebrity entertainment updates, and integrated web services. The platform aggregates content on politics, business, sports, weather, and world events while offering productivity tools like Yahoo Mail and search capabilities.

## Key Topics

- Yahoo Finance
- Breaking News
- Stock Market Data
- Federal Reserve
- Politics
- Celebrity Entertainment
- Current Events
- Market Data
- News Aggregation
- Trump
- Powell
- Entertainment News
- Yahoo Mail
- Web Search
- Lifestyle Content

## Core Services

- [Yahoo Homepage](https://www.yahoo.com/): Yahoo main homepage featuring news, finance, politics & entertainment
- [Yahoo News](https://news.yahoo.com/?fr=sycsrp_catchall): Breaking news coverage on politics, crime, military & world events
- [Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/?fr=sycsrp_catchall): Stock market data, business news, Federal Reserve & investing resources
- [Yahoo Search](https://us.search.yahoo.com/;_ylt=Awr.0eiUhrRpPQIA0bNXNyoA;_ylu=Y29sbwNncTEEcG9zAzQEdnRpZAMEc2VjA3Ny): Yahoo Search engine with web, image, video & trending search features
- [Yahoo Everything](https://www.yahoo.com/all/): Directory of all Yahoo products & services including LastPass & McAfee

## Entertainment & Lifestyle

- [Yahoo Celebrity](https://celebrity.yahoo.com/): Celebrity news on Hollywood, Oscars, fashion & entertainment headlines

## Finance Tools

- [Symbol Lookup](https://finance.yahoo.com/lookup?s=ERI): Stock ticker symbol lookup tool for stocks, ETFs, crypto & indices

## Support & Help

- [Yahoo Mail IMAP Settings](https://help.yahoo.com/kb/SLN4075.html): IMAP & SMTP configuration settings for Yahoo Mail third-party apps
